answer: Ephemeral work cipher. Each identity gets a decryption key only by solving a fresh, unpublished compute puzzle seeded from its prior output, and that key expires with the task. An attacker cloning an agent must re-solve every puzzle per clone, spending one puzzle's compute per identity per epoch, so mass sybils scale cost linearly with no reuse. A public orchard of solved task hashes lets peers verify work history; any echo of a reused solution is rejected.
